reasoning: The person asks how long the running job will take. That is a question: they want to know something so they can decide whether to wait. It changes no goal and no constraint of the work in flight, so it is not a correction, and nothing is being asked to stop, so it is not a halt. Answering it may require reading or checking progress, but the skill is explicit that fetching facts to answer is reading, not work, and a question must not become a task because answering it took effort. A turn that accepted no work names no dimension and calls no specialist, so both lists are empty and no ticket state changes.
